site_audit.scope_note: The ad CTA says Call now, not website. The index.html page was separately reviewed because the root URL was inaccessible to the checker. The call destination and form submission were not tested.

issues: The ad uses Call now; verify which number the button calls and how calls are followed up.
The homepage has an enquiry form; its submission and success state were not tested.
The homepage validator reported 29 errors and one warning; review the actual markup rather than assuming visitor impact.

site_evidence.note: Partial homepage source review; runtime behavior and ad destination not inferred.

promise_gap: Ad: solar for homes, schools, hospitals, industries and commercial buildings.
The separately reviewed website lists multiple service and solution segments; the actual ad action is Call now.
Ad: call either of two numbers.
Both numbers appear on the website; the number behind the CTA was not verified.
recommended_steps: Verify the dialled number and missed-call follow-up.
Run a controlled submission and confirm a success message.
Prioritise actionable issues from the Nu HTML checker.
Check tag deployment and lead events in account tools.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
